questions.question: Before Israel entered the promised land, why did Moses teach them God's statutes and ordinances?

answers.text: So they would live and take the land
So they would earn back their freedom
So they would keep Moses as leader

questions.question: When the LORD spoke to Israel out of the fire at Mount Horeb, the people saw His form. True or false?
After the LORD spoke to Israel from the fire at Horeb, what did Moses warn them not to make?

answers.text: An idol of any form or shape
An altar out of cut stones
